reason: Both conversations give the correct critical safety stop (unplug, do not use, engineer before further use), but Conversation 1 ends there with no diagnosis, no questions and no acknowledgement of the homeowner's situation. Conversation 2 explicitly rules out running it 'even as a test' (matching the customer's own refusal), asks about the lint filter (a key unknown), and correctly identifies lint build-up as the likely contributory cause while still insisting on an engineer inspection rather than declaring it safe after cleaning. Conversation 2's weakness is its somewhat confident 'very likely the cause' phrasing and failure to ask about smoke or the vent hose, but it still served the homeowner more honestly and usefully than Conversation 1's bare warning.
